architecture_reading: The 72-tick oscillator frame is an ISA frame.  The first q!=6 route digits form the 48-tick tomotope packet body.  The final q=3 route digits form a 24-tick local-lift epilogue, split as 18 payload lanes plus 6 F3 parity lanes. Existing BT828 route programs lower into the 8-tick word [3 Q3 XOR ops, 5 apartment hop ops]; the level-six stress route fills the tomotope body with one tick of slack.
honesty_boundary: This is a deterministic instruction layout and coverage theorem for the existing BT828 compiler packets. It is not yet a shortest path optimizer for the full 540-chart atlas.
